newsitem.title: INDIA: India says new issues fell in Apr-Dec 96.
newsitem.headline: India says new issues fell in Apr-Dec 96.

text.p: India said on Tuesday that funds raised by firms from new capital issues fell to 103.69 billion rupees in the first nine months of 1996/97 (April-March) from 141.51 billion in the same period of 1995/96.

The number of issues fell to 793 from 1,132, the government said in its annual Economic Survey for 1996/97. "The declining trend in issues and funds raised through the primary market is expected to continue," the survey said.
